purpose: Exploratory low-load negative control for the static path-space mechanism.
reason_for_amendment: The earlier 350 offered-token/s condition left 28-39 requests backlogged and completed only 63-73% in 300 seconds, so it was not an idle control.
condition: C1_single frozen placement, 100 offered token/s, seed 100, 300 seconds, zero warmup, no tail drain
controls: Same M3 ranking, executed-layer KV admission, physical resources, model and request trace; only allowed path space differs.
interpretation: Exploratory because the load was chosen after observing the 350-window backlog. Report completion and backlog alongside latency; do not use this to select a method or claim statistical significance.
